name: Dreaming of Dana
source:
You take on the role of rich kid that has had everything handed to him his entire life making him quite an indolent little ass.

Now he is working for his father's company and not enjoying himself too much. Working alongside him is his sister Dana, the apple of his father's eye, for whom he is slowly discovering long buried and forgotten feelings.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/PTOLEMYGAMES]Patreon[/url]]
